blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LiDAR point clouds acquired in underground environments exhibit severe geometric incompleteness due to occlusions and limited sensor viewpoints, making reliable point cloud completion challenging without large supervised datasets. We propose ZVeC , a zero-shot, instance-driven framework that reformulates scene-level completion as compositional object-level reconstruction. By decomposing a scene into semantic object instances, ZVeC reduces reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered environments while eliminating the need for scenario-specific training. Each segmented vehicle is completed independently using a depth- and 3D Gaussian-conditioned diffusion model that exploits generalized geometric priors before the reconstructed instances are recomposed into the original scene. To evaluate our approach, we construct a real-world dense LiDAR benchmark of underground parking environments. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The completed point cloud differs substantially from the measured input (average KL divergence ∼ \sim 2.1), yet reducing the input to only 1% of the original LiDAR measurements changes the completed reconstruction only marginally (KL divergence < 0.50 <0.50 ). This demonstrates that ZVeC produces geometrically consistent completions even under extreme input sparsity.
blocks.zh: 在地下环境中获得的LiDAR点云由于被隐蔽和传感器视线有限而显示出严重的几何不全,使得没有大型监督数据集的可靠点云完成工作面临挑战. 我们提出 ZVeC,一个零镜头,实例驱动的框架,将场景级完成重构为组成对象级重建. ZVeC通过将一个场景分解成语义对象实例,减少杂乱环境中的重建模糊性,同时消除了对情景特定训练的需要. 每节编组车厢均独立完成,采用深度和3D高斯条件扩散模型,在重建实例重新组合到原场前利用通用几何前缀. 为了评价我们的方法,我们构建了一个真实世界密集的地下停车环境LiDAR基准. 实验结果表明,在定量衡量和视觉质量方面,比有代表性的场景基线有持续改善。 完成点云与测量的输入值(平均KL差 \\\sim 2.1)有很大不同,但将输入值减少到最初LiDAR测量值的1%,只略微改变完成的重建值(KL差 < 0.50 < 0.50)。 这表明,ZVeC即使在极端输入抽筋的情况下也能产生几何一致的完成.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reliable understanding of LiDAR point clouds is fundamental to applications including autonomous driving, robotic navigation, and 3D digital twin construction ( Guo et al. 2021 ; Cui et al. 2022 ) . However, point clouds acquired from a single LiDAR pass often suffer from severe geometric incompleteness due to limited viewpoints, weak returns, and heavy occlusions ( Qin et al. 2020 ; Bresson et al. 2017 ; Yuan et al. 2018a ) . Since LiDAR cannot penetrate solid objects, large portions of object geometry remain unobserved, making point cloud completion a critical step for reliable scene understanding and reconstruction ( Yu et al. 2021 ; Xie et al. 2020a ) .
blocks.zh: 对LiDAR点云的可靠理解对于包括自主驾驶,机器人导航,以及3D数字双层构造在内的应用(Guo et al. 2021; Cui等人 2022 (英语). 然而,从单一的LiDAR通行证中获取的点云由于观点有限,回报率低,以及重聚等原因,经常出现严重的几何不完整(秦等). 2020; Bresson 等人 2017; Yuan 等人 2018a). 从 LiDAR无法穿透固体物体,大片物体几何特征仍然无人观察,使得点云完成成为可靠的场景理解和重建的关键步骤(Yu等人. 2021; 谢等2020a).

blocks.en: Traditional point cloud completion methods rely on geometric assumptions such as symmetry, surface smoothness, or template matching, limiting their ability to recover heavily occluded structures. Recent learning-based methods generally follow either scene-level or instance-level paradigms ( Zhang et al. 2024 ) . Scene-level approaches reconstruct entire environments but struggle in cluttered scenes where interactions among neighboring objects introduce significant ambiguity. Instance-level methods alleviate this issue by exploiting category-level shape priors. However, most existing approaches require supervised training on large paired datasets collected under specific acquisition settings, reducing their robustness to domain shifts encountered in real-world deployments.
blocks.zh: 传统的点云完成方法依赖于对称性,表面光滑性,或模板匹配等几何假设,限制了它们恢复严重占用结构的能力. 最近以学习为基础的方法一般都遵循场景一级或实例一级的模式(Zhang等人,2024年)。 场景层面的方法重建了整个环境,但在杂乱无章的场景中挣扎,邻居物体之间的相互作用造成了重大的模糊性。 实例一级的方法通过利用类别一级形状的前身来缓解这一问题。 然而,大多数现有方法都要求就在特定购置环境下收集的大配对数据集进行有监督的培训,降低其稳健性,使其适应在实际世界部署中遇到的域位变化。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed ZVeC pipeline. The input point cloud is first preprocessed by removing the ceiling, ground, and noise before being partitioned into individual vehicle instances using a Segment Anything Model-based instance segmentation module. Each normalized instance is then completed using our GenPC-based completion module, after which the reconstructed instances are transformed back and reinserted into the original scene to produce the final completed point cloud.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议的ZVeC管道概述。 输入点云首先通过删除天花板、地面和噪音进行预处理,然后使用基于模型的分区模块,被分割成单个车辆实例。 然后使用基于GenPC的完成模块完成每个正常化实例,然后将重建实例转换回原场,重新插入原场,生成最终完成点云.

blocks.en: Underground parking environments present a particularly challenging setting because severe occlusions and restricted viewpoints make complete supervision prohibitively expensive to obtain. Nevertheless, parked vehicles exhibit strong category-level geometric regularities despite substantial missing observations. This suggests that scene completion need not be formulated as a global reconstruction problem. Instead, decomposing the scene into semantic object instances transforms completion into independent geometric inference over a low-dimensional object shape space, reducing reconstruction ambiguity while enabling zero-shot completion through generalized geometric priors rather than scene-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 地下停车环境是一个特别具有挑战性的环境,因为严重的堵塞和限制观点使得完全的监管费用过高。 尽管如此,尽管有大量的观测结果缺失,但停靠的车辆显示出强烈的类别几何规律。 这表明,完成现场工作不必成为全球重建问题。 相反,将场景分解成语义物体实例,将完成在低维物体形状空间上转化为独立的几何推论,减少重建模糊度,同时通过通用几何前身而非场景特定监督,实现零射完成.

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose ZVeC , a zero-shot, instance-driven framework for point cloud completion in real-world LiDAR scenes. Rather than learning a scene-specific reconstruction model, ZVeC completes each object independently using our proposed GenPC module, which recovers missing geometry from partial observations without additional training or fine-tuning. The framework first extracts vehicle instances using a Segment Anything Model-based segmentation module, applies zero-shot completion to each normalized instance, and finally recomposes the reconstructed objects into the original scene while preserving the global spatial layout.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提出 ZVeC, 一个零镜头,实例驱动的框架 在现实世界的LiDAR场景中点云完成。 ZVeC不是学习特定场景的重建模型,而是使用我们拟议的GenPC模块独立完成每个对象,它从部分观察中恢复缺失的几何学,而没有额外的训练或微调. 框架首先使用一个基于September Anything Model的分区模块提取车辆实例,将零镜头完成应用到每个规范化实例中,最后在保留全球空间布局的同时将重建的物体重新组合到原场.

blocks.en: This formulation offers three key advantages. First, instance-level decomposition reduces interference from neighboring objects and background clutter. Second, zero-shot completion improves generalization across diverse environments by avoiding scene-specific supervision. Third, the recovered instance representations naturally support downstream applications including digital twin construction, semantic mapping, and scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 这种提法有三个主要优点。 首先,实例级分解会减少来自邻接对象的干扰和背景杂乱. 第二,零镜头完成通过避免特定场景的监督,改善对不同环境的概括. 第三,回收的实例表示自然支持下游应用,包括数字双体构造,语义制图,以及场景理解.

blocks.en: To evaluate our approach, we construct a dense real-world LiDAR benchmark collected in underground parking environments. Although the scans contain high point densities, severe occlusions and limited viewpoints create substantial missing geometry, providing a realistic benchmark for zero-shot completion. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality, particularly in recovering fine-grained vehicle structures.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的方法,我们构建了一个在地下停车环境中收集的密集真实世界LiDAR基准。 虽然扫描包含高点密度,但严重的隐蔽和有限的观点造成了大量缺失的几何学,为零镜头完成提供了现实的基准. 实验结果表明,在数量计量和视觉质量方面,特别是在恢复精细车辆结构方面,比有代表性的场景基线有持续改善。

blocks.en: Contributions. • We propose ZVeC , a zero-shot framework that reformulates scene-level point cloud completion as compositional instance-level reconstruction, reducing reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered LiDAR scenes through object-wise completion with the proposed GenPC module. • We introduce a real-world underground parking LiDAR benchmark for evaluating zero-shot point cloud completion under realistic occlusions and incomplete observations. 1 1 1 Our dataset will be released after double blind peer-review. • Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines and robust reconstruction under extreme input sparsity, maintaining geometrically consistent completions using only 1% of the original input points.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Instance-level Point Cloud Completion
blocks.zh: 2.1 点云完成

blocks.en: Instance-level point cloud completion aims to recover complete object geometry from sparse and partial observations ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Yu et al. 2023 ) . Early learning-based methods, including PCN ( Yuan et al. 2018b ) and GRNet ( Xie et al. 2020b ) , established encoder-decoder architectures for directly reconstructing complete shapes from partial point clouds. Recent advances have shifted the field toward Transformer-based and generative models ( Yu et al. 2021 ; Chen et al. 2024 ; Yu et al. 2023 ; Kasten et al. 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 实例级点云的完成旨在从稀疏和局部观测中恢复完整的天体几何(Chen et al. 2024; Yu et al. 2023 ). 早期的学习方法,包括PCN(袁等2018b)和GRNet(谢等2020b),建立了编码器-解码器架构,用于从部分点云直接重建完整的形状. 最近的进展使该领域转向了基于变形器和基因模型(Yu等人)。 2021; 陈等. 2024; Yu 等人 2023; Kasten 等人 2023).

blocks.en: Transformers improve completion by modeling long-range geometric dependencies through self-attention ( Yu et al. 2021 ) . PoinTr ( Yu et al. 2021 ) formulates completion as a set-to-set translation task by representing point clouds as geometry-aware point proxies within a Transformer encoder-decoder. AdaPoinTr ( Yu et al. 2023 ) extends this framework with adaptive query generation and multi-scale geometric feature extraction. To better recover local geometry, SnowflakeNet ( Xiang et al. 2021 ) introduces a Skip-Transformer with progressive point splitting, while SeedFormer ( Zhou et al. 2022 ) employs hierarchical “Patch Seeds” for coarse-to-fine shape generation.
blocks.zh: 变形器通过自觉模拟长程几何的依赖性来改进完成性(Yu等人,2021年). PoinTr(Yu et al. 2021)通过将点云表示为变形器编码器-解码器内的几何感知点代词,将完成表述为设定到设定的翻译任务. AdaPoinTr(Yu等人,2023年)通过适应性查询生成和多尺度几何特征提取来扩展这个框架. 为了更好地恢复局部几何,雪花网(Xiang et al. 2021)引入了Skip-Transformer,递进点分法,而SeedFormer(Zhou et al. 2022)则使用分级的"Patch种子"来进行粗细的形状生成.

blocks.en: Despite their strong benchmark performance, these methods rely primarily on geometric observations, resulting in ambiguous predictions under severe occlusions or out-of-distribution inputs. Recent work addresses this limitation by incorporating generative image priors. SDS-Complete ( Kasten et al. 2023 ) performs test-time optimization using Score Distillation Sampling and a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model, enabling zero-shot completion without large-scale 3D supervision at significant computational cost. In contrast, GenPC ( Li et al. 2025 ) leverages feed-forward image-to-3D generative priors with depth prompting and geometry-preserving fusion, enabling efficient zero-shot completion of real-world scans without iterative optimization while conditioning on depth observations from the input point cloud.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些方法的基准性能很强,但主要依靠几何观测,导致在严重隔离或分配外投入下作出模棱两可的预测。 最近的工作通过纳入基因图案前身来解决这一限制。 SDS-Complete(Kasten等人,2023年)利用分数分散取样和预先训练的文本到图像传播模型进行测试时间优化,使得零镜头完成时无需大规模3D监督,计算成本高昂. 相比之下,GenPC(Li等人,2025年)利用向导图像到3D的基因前传带深度激发和几何保存聚变,使得在从输入点云对深度观测进行条件化的同时,无需迭代优化即可高效地零发完成现实世界扫描.

blocks.en: 2.2 3D Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 3D 实例分割

blocks.en: Recent 3D indoor instance segmentation methods can be broadly categorized into native 3D approaches and 2D-to-3D lifting methods. Early native 3D methods, including GSPN ( Yi et al. 2019 ) , 3D-BoNet ( Yang et al. 2019 ) , and OccuSeg ( Han et al. 2020 ) , introduced proposal-based and occupancy-aware paradigms for directly segmenting object instances from point clouds. More recent bottom-up approaches, such as PointGroup ( Jiang et al. 2020 ) , HAIS ( Chen et al. 2021 ) , and SoftGroup ( Vu et al. 2022 ) , progressively improved instance grouping through point clustering and hierarchical aggregation, while Transformer-based methods such as Mask3D ( Schult et al. 2023 ) directly predict instance masks using learnable object queries. Although highly effective, these native 3D methods remain limited by severe occlusions and the scarcity of densely annotated 3D datasets.
blocks.zh: 最近的3D室内实例分离方法可大致分为本地3D方法和2D至3D提升方法。 早期本地3D方法,包括PPKN(Yi等人,2019年),3D-BoNet(Yang等人,2019年),OccuSeg(Han等人,2020年),为从点云直接分化物体事件引入了基于建议书和占用意识的范式. 较近期的自下而上的方法,如PointGroup(Jiang 等人,2020年),HAIS(Chen等人,2021年),SoftGroup(Vu等人,2022年)等,通过点集和分级汇总,逐渐改进了实例分组,而Mask3D(Schult等人,2023年)等基于变形器的方法则利用可学习对象查询直接预测实例口罩. 这些本地的3D方法虽然非常有效,但是仍然受到严重堵塞和缺少注释繁多的3D数据集的限制.

blocks.en: To reduce dependence on large-scale 3D annotations, 2D-to-3D lifting methods leverage mature 2D vision models ( Jatavallabhula et al. 2023 ; Peng et al. 2023 ) . These approaches first segment objects in multi-view RGB-D images before projecting the resulting masks into 3D using camera geometry ( Miao et al. 2025 ; Yin et al. 2024 ) . PanopticFusion ( Narita et al. 2019 ) fuses 2D instance predictions into a volumetric TSDF representation, while 3D-SIS ( Hou et al. 2019 ) lifts high-resolution RGB features to improve 3D instance segmentation. A key challenge in 2D-to-3D lifting is maintaining multi-view consistency, as objects are observed from varying viewpoints, scales, and occlusion patterns. Recent methods ( Peng et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2026 ) address this using spatial-temporal fusion, bipartite graph matching, or 3D consensus clustering to merge redundant predictions into coherent object instances. Following this paradigm, we perform instance segmentation in Bird’s-Eye View (BEV) space and exploit the zero-shot capability of Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) ( Carion et al. 2026 ) to obtain accurate instance boundaries.
blocks.zh: 为了减少对大尺度3D说明的依赖,2D至3D提升方法利用成熟的2D视觉模型(Jatavallabhula等人,2023年;Peng等人,2023年). 这些方法在多视图RGB-D图像中的第一段对象,然后利用相机几何来投射产生的口罩为3D(Miao等人. 2025; 殷等编. 2024). 泛光聚变. (Narita等人,2019年)将2D实例预测导入体积TSDF代表,而3D-SIS(Hou等人,2019年)则提升高分辨率RGB特征,以改善3D实例分解. 2D至3D升空中的一个关键挑战是保持多视图一致性,因为从不同的观点、尺度和隔离模式观察到物体。 近代方法 (Peng et al. 2023 ; Chen 等人 2026))用空间-时态聚变,双方图匹配,或3D共识集群来将冗余预测合并为连贯的对象实例来解决这个问题. 遵循这一模式,我们在鸟眼景区(BEV)空间进行实例分解,并利用分块任意模式3(SAM3)(Carion等人,2026年)的零瞄准能力,以获得准确实例边界。

blocks.zh: 3.1 数据处理

blocks.en: To efficiently process large-scale parking lot point clouds, we introduce a multi-stage preprocessing pipeline that reduces computational cost. Exploiting the prior that the ceiling and ground form near-parallel horizontal planes, we perform Z Z -axis histogram slicing followed by RANSAC plane fitting on the highest and lowest slices to estimate the boundary planes. A gravity-axis height filter then removes ground points and points exceeding a vehicle height of 2 ​ m 2\,\mathrm{m} .

blocks.en: Our GenPC-based completion module reconstructs complete vehicle geometries from sparse partial scans using the zero-shot framework of GenPC ( Li et al. 2025 ) . Given a normalized point cloud 𝒫 i ​ n ⊆ ℝ N × 3 \mathcal{P}_{in}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{N\times 3} and semantic prompt T i ​ n T_{in} (e.g., “car”), the input is projected to a coarse depth map D r ​ a ​ w D_{raw} . A diffusion-based depth inpainting model produces a completed depth map D c D_{c} , which conditions a ControlNet to synthesize an RGB image I g ​ e ​ n I_{gen} . The generated image is then converted into an initial complete point cloud 𝒫 g ​ e ​ n \mathcal{P}_{gen} using a pre-trained image-to-3D model.

blocks.en: We validated our pipeline on our newly collected real-world dense LiDAR point cloud dataset of an underground parking lot using an Orbis mobile scanning system. The acquisition was conducted over an approximately 8-minute scanning sequence, capturing dense LiDAR observations of parked vehicles, structural elements, and surrounding indoor geometry. Based on a robust estimate of the horizontal spatial extent of the reconstructed point cloud, the scanned area covers approximately 36 ​ m × 40 ​ m 36\mathrm{m}\times 40\mathrm{m} . The per-point attributes in our dataset comprise spatial coordinates (x, y, z), intensity, and GPS time. Despite the relatively high density of the scan, localized data gaps and geometric incompleteness remain due to occlusions and limited viewpoints in a realistic single-pass drive through.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en: Since complete ground-truth geometry is unavailable for real-world LiDAR scans, conventional full-reference evaluation cannot be directly applied. 4.3 Point Cloud Completion Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 点云完成结果

blocks.en: Table 2: Incremental ablation of the proposed normalization pipeline. Lower is better.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Reconstruction results for a representative vehicle instance under varying levels of input sparsity. Despite significant differences in the number of input points, the completed geometry remains largely unchanged, demonstrating the robustness of the method to input sparsity.
blocks.zh: 图4 具有代表性的车辆的重建结果,投入垃圾堆积程度不同。 尽管输入点数量存在显著差异,但完成的几何学基本保持不变,表明输入螺旋性的方法很坚固.

blocks.en: The quantitative results demonstrate consistent reconstruction quality across all 15 vehicle instances. For the no-reference metrics in Table 1 and Figure 3 (surface smoothness scaled by × 10 \times 10 for visualization), surface smoothness ( 0.010 ± 0.001 0.010\pm 0.001 ) and density CV ( 0.109 ± 0.003 0.109\pm 0.003 ) exhibit very small variance, indicating smooth surfaces and uniform point sampling across the completed vehicles. Voxel coverage averages 0.161 ± 0.021 0.161\pm 0.021 , reflecting expected variation in the amount of recovered geometry due to differing occlusion levels.

blocks.en: For the full-reference metrics in Table 1 and Figure 3 (KL divergence scaled by 1 10 \frac{1}{10} ), KL divergence averages 2.121 ± 0.359 2.121\pm 0.359 , indicating varying degrees of point density redistribution during completion. In contrast, EMD ( 0.239 ± 0.045 0.239\pm 0.045 ), Sinkhorn distance ( 0.288 ± 0.044 0.288\pm 0.044 ), and the Chamfer L1 ( 0.094 ± 0.018 0.094\pm 0.018 ) and L2 ( 0.143 ± 0.036 0.143\pm 0.036 ) distances remain consistently low with relatively small variance, demonstrating stable geometric alignment between the completed and observed point clouds.

blocks.en: Unlike EMD, Sinkhorn, and Chamfer distances, which measure geometric correspondence, KL divergence quantifies changes in the underlying point density distribution and is therefore more sensitive to the redistribution of probability mass introduced during completion. We consequently use KL divergence to guide the qualitative analysis while reporting all metrics.
blocks.zh: 与测量几何对应的EMD,Sinkhorn,以及Chamfer距离不同,KL差异将基点密度分布的变化量化,因此对完成时引入的概率质量的再分配更为敏感. 因此,我们利用KL差异来指导质量分析,同时报告所有衡量标准。

blocks.en: This behavior is illustrated by Instances 6 and 14 in Figure 2(c) . Instance 6 exhibits the highest KL divergence due to severe occlusions, density imbalance, and segmentation artifacts (red box), requiring substantial redistribution of point density during completion. Nevertheless, the reconstructed geometry remains visually coherent, consistent with the stable no-reference and geometric correspondence metrics. In contrast, Instance 14 exhibits the lowest KL divergence because the input already closely approximates the underlying vehicle geometry, requiring only minor refinement during completion.
blocks.zh: 图2(c)第6和第14例说明了这种行为。 实例6显示KL差异最大,原因是严重封存、密度失衡和分块文物(红盒),在完成过程中需要大量重新分配点密度。 尽管如此,重建后的几何仍与稳定的无参考和几何对应的测量一致。 与此相反,第14号案例显示的KL差异最小,因为输入值已接近车辆几何基础,只需在完成时稍作改进。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: To validate instance-to-scene grounding, we perform an ablation with four variants that progressively incorporate normalization and grounding. A near-complete instance is selected from the raw point cloud as the reference, and a partial input is generated by removing surface regions before completion. Performance is evaluated against the reference using symmetric Chamfer Distance (L1/L2), EMD, and Sinkhorn Distance.
blocks.zh: 为了验证从实例到地面的铺设,我们用四个变体进行铺设,逐步纳入正常化和地面铺设。 从原始点云中选择一个近乎完整的实例作为参考,通过在完成前移除表面区域生成部分输入. 使用对称的Chamfer距离(L1/L2)、EMD和Sinkhorn距离来对照参考评价性能。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , removing normalization and grounding substantially degrades performance, confirming their importance. Centering alone provides only marginal improvement, while omitting the coordinate transformation further reduces accuracy, demonstrating that Z-up to Y-up alignment is essential. The full normalization pipeline consistently achieves the best performance.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,取消正常化和打地基会大大降低业绩,从而证实其重要性。 单靠中心只能提供边际改进,而忽略坐标转换会进一步降低准确性,表明Z-up到Y-up对齐至关重要. 全面正常化的管道一贯取得最佳业绩。

blocks.en: 4.5 Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 强性分析

blocks.en: To evaluate robustness under varying observation sparsity, we randomly downsample the input point clouds to retention ratios of 50%, 25%, 10%, 5%, and 1%. KL divergence measures the difference between completions generated from downsampled and full-resolution inputs, as well as between the completed and raw point clouds.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不同观察的坚固度,我们随机将输入点云到保留率的50%、25%、10%、5%和1%。 KL 差异度测量了由下取样输入和全分辨率输入产生的完成度之间的差别,以及完成点云和生点云之间的差别.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , the completed point clouds remain highly consistent with the full-resolution completions. The KL divergence increases only from 0.2904 at 50% retention to 0.4955 at 1% retention, while Figure 4 shows strong structural consistency across all sparsity levels. In contrast, the divergence between the completed and raw point clouds is substantially larger, reflecting the incompleteness of the observations. These results demonstrate that the proposed completion framework is robust to extreme input sparsity, producing consistent geometries even when only 1% of the original points are retained.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,完成点云与全分辨率完成高度一致。 KL差异只从保留50%的0.2904增加到保留1%的0.4955,而图4显示,所有垃圾等级的结构都十分一致。 相比之下,完成的点云和生的点云之间的差异要大得多,反映了观测结果的不完整. 这些结果表明,拟议的完成框架对极端的输入性很强,即使只保留了1%的原始点,也会产生一致的几何数据。

blocks.en: 4.6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.6 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our newly collected dataset lacks complete ground truth, so evaluation reflects a realistic deployment setting rather than exact reconstruction accuracy. We therefore assess per-instance geometric quality using no-reference metrics, quantify geometric and distributional changes before and after completion, and evaluate robustness under varying input sparsity. Manual inspection further confirms the plausibility and structural consistency of all completed instances. Future work will investigate automated point cloud quality assessment metrics for scalable evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们新收集的数据集缺乏完整的地面真实性,因此评价反映了现实的部署环境,而不是确切的重建准确性。 因此,我们使用无参考量度评估每英寸几何质量,在完成之前和之后量化几何和分布变化,并在不同的输入抽筋下评价稳健性。 人工检查进一步证实了所有已完成案例的可信度和结构一致性。 今后的工作将调查可扩展评价的自动点云质量评估指标。

blocks.en: Although this study focuses on vehicle reconstruction in indoor parking environments, the framework is largely environment- and class-agnostic. Future work will evaluate generalization to outdoor scenes and additional object categories, including pedestrians, traffic signs, and autonomous driving datasets, while introducing task-specific adaptations where necessary.
blocks.zh: 虽然本研究的重点是室内停车环境中的车辆重建,但这一框架基本上是环境和阶级不可知的。 今后的工作将评价户外场景的概况和包括行人、交通标志和自动驾驶数据集在内的其他物体类别,同时在必要时引入针对具体任务的调整。

blocks.en: This work also advances object-centric digital twin representations. Future research will investigate object-level meshing and scene graph-based modeling with per-object pose, semantic attributes, and geometric descriptors for digital twin creations.
blocks.zh: 这项工作还推进了以物体为中心的数字双向表示。 未来的研究将调查以每个对象的姿势、语义属性和几何描述符为数字双子创造的物体水平的测量和场景图形模型。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose ZVeC, a zero-shot, instance-driven framework for point cloud completion in underground parking environments, following a compositional scene completion pipeline. By transforming a complex scene-level problem into instance-level reconstruction tasks, our method effectively overcomes the geometric incompleteness in point clouds caused by occlusions and clutter. Experiments on a real-world dense LiDAR dataset demonstrate that our framework achieves high-fidelity reconstructions both qualitatively and quantitatively.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出ZVeC,一个零镜头,实例驱动的框架,用于在地下停车环境中完成点云,在组成场景完成管道之后. 通过将复杂的场景层面问题转变为实例层面的重建任务,我们的方法有效地克服了被隔离和杂乱无章造成的点云的几何不完全. 对现实世界密集的LiDAR数据集的实验表明,我们的框架在质量和数量上都实现了高可靠性重建。

blocks.en: Beyond this specific scenario, ZVeC highlights the effectiveness of a zero-shot, instance-driven formulation for handling incomplete observations in structured environments. This paradigm provides a scalable and generalizable direction for robust 3D scene reconstruction and can benefit a range of downstream perception tasks, such as intelligent object-based scene representation for autonomous driving, embodied systems, and digital twin creation.
blocks.zh: 除了这一具体情景外,ZVeC还突出了在结构化环境中处理不完整观测的零镜头、实例驱动的配方的有效性。 这个范式为强力的3D场景重建提供了可伸缩和可概括的方向,并可以使一系列下游感知任务受益,如智能的基于物体的场景表现用于自主驾驶,包含的系统,以及数字双创.
